import sqlite3

# Example of parameterized query to prevent SQL injection
def fetch_products_by_tags(tags):
    conn = sqlite3.connect('db.sqlite3')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    placeholders = ','.join('?' for _ in tags)
    query = f"SELECT DISTINCT product_name FROM products JOIN product_tags ON products.id = product_tags.product_id WHERE product_tags.tag IN ({placeholders})"
    cursor.execute(query, tags)
    results = cursor.fetchall()
    conn.close()
